engines.label: AutoDock Vina
engines.primary_ranking_metric: Empirical Vina score (kcal/mol, ascending / more negative)
engines.result_model: Pose-native modes with inter-mode RMSD lower and upper bounds
engines.cross_engine_rank_comparison: Supported against AutoDock4 CPU library campaigns sharing exact receptor, finalized binding site, and applied selection manifest (Spearman rank correlation and Top-N overlap; zero merged score)
engines.scientific_notes: Empirical Vina score is not experimental binding free energy; inter-mode RMSD bounds are not crystallographic reference RMSD.

engines.label: AutoDock4 (CPU)
engines.primary_ranking_metric: Estimated free energy of binding (kcal/mol, ascending / more negative)
engines.result_model: Cluster/run-native DLG hierarchy over immutable AutoGrid4 4.2.6 affinity maps
engines.cross_engine_rank_comparison: Supported against AutoDock Vina library campaigns sharing exact receptor, finalized binding site, and applied selection manifest (Spearman rank correlation and Top-N overlap; zero merged score)
engines.scientific_notes: Stock AutoGrid4 4.2.6 enforces 14 ligand and 20 receptor atom-type ceilings; Meeko macrocycle glue types (CG0/G0) fail preflight explicitly without coercion.

engines.label: AutoDock-GPU
execution_modes: OpenCL GPU (Windows) / CUDA 12 GPU (Linux) · single ligand
engines.primary_ranking_metric: AutoDock4 scoring-family energy (kcal/mol, ascending / more negative)
engines.result_model: Cluster/run-native DLG hierarchy over shared immutable AutoGrid4 4.2.6 affinity maps
engines.cross_engine_rank_comparison: Shares the AutoDock4 scoring family (not an independent scoring vote from AutoDock4 CPU); not directly loaded by the Vina/AutoDock4 CPU comparison service
engines.scientific_notes: Parallel GPU search uses its own Solis-Wets/ADADELTA protocol and is not assumed bitwise reproducible (DOCKING_GPU_REPRODUCIBILITY_UNVERIFIED); requires compatible host vendor GPU driver.

engines.label: GNINA
execution_modes: CPU or CUDA 12.8 GPU · single ligand or sequential library screening (rescore)
CUDA 12.8 GPU only · single ligand or sequential library screening (refinement, timeout >= 10 min)
engines.primary_ranking_metric: Within-ligand: CNNscore [0, 1] descending; Screening hit prioritization: cnn_score or cnn_vs (CNNscore * CNNaffinity) descending
engines.result_model: CNN-ordered poses preserving separate CNNscore (dimensionless), CNNaffinity (pK), CNN_VS, optional CNNaffinity_variance (only when emitted), and minimizedAffinity (kcal/mol)
engines.cross_engine_rank_comparison: Maintained as a distinct CNN scoring family; never pooled or Spearman-merged with Vina or AutoDock4 scores
engines.scientific_notes: Built-in models pinned to verified GNINA 1.3.3 SHA-256: dense_1_3 (1 model, default), default_1_3_ensemble (3 KD models, CLI omits --cnn), and default1.0 (5 models). Under refinement, minimizedAffinity is evaluated on CNN-refined geometry and is not an independent empirical energy check. Deferred on Windows.
